editor.journey:
1. Place materials in your backpack or ordinary chests within 5 tiles of the workbench. Older bead recipes are no longer used.
2. Choose a product and colors. Use the side panel on small windows. Open Bead colors to change your favorite colors; no color unlocks are required.
3. Use the bead pen to place beads; use tweezers or right click to remove them. Changing the selected color does not repaint existing beads.
4. Furniture and decorations use ordinary beads automatically; clothing uses wool. Weapons let you choose metals, gems, and extra materials.
5. Fuse the design when it is ready. Existing beads are used first, then raw materials; leftovers are kept. Review the exact cost before confirming. No materials are used if the product cannot fit.
6. To refine beads, select an ordinary metal or gem in the weapon menu and prepare it through More. A furnace turns 10 beads and 1 Coal into 5 refined beads in 30 minutes.
7. Save your designs and let the game save normally. Hats and shirts require all four views. Read item art can use vanilla designs as a starting point.
Shortcuts: Ctrl+Z / Y to undo / redo; wheel to zoom; Space-drag to pan. More contains import, centering, and auxiliary tools.
